display.purpose: The one decision sentence at the top of the table.

heading.purpose: Review verdict and major panel titles.

body.purpose: Coaching prose, review detail, and all reading copy.

small.purpose: Event rows, metadata, and secondary explanations.

label.purpose: Match-strip labels, rail section heads, and status tags.

shadows.name: dock-active

shadows.name: modal
shadows.purpose: Separates the guide and settings dialogs from the table.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: The small physical lift under a playing card.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: A legal card rising toward the pointer.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and button state changes.

motion.name: reduce-motion

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single available action: bid, play, or deal the next hand.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid #c9ff8d; background: #bff576; color: #15220f; font: 800 14px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #d0ff9c; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #bff576; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A supporting action such as Pass or Run again.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(200,222,204,.26); background: #1b3323; color: #d1ddd3; font: 700 14px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #23402c; color: #f1f8ef; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #bff576; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Match Strip
components.description: The only home for match score, hand, contract, dealer, and turn state.
components.css: .ds-match-strip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 22px; min-height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(200,222,204,.15); background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(18,30,23,.92), rgba(12,21,16,.92)); color: #eef5ee; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-match-strip-team { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; } .ds-match-strip-team span, .ds-match-strip-meta span { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .09em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #93a796; font-weight: 800; } .ds-match-strip-team strong { font-size: 20px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-match-strip-meta { display: flex; gap: 22px; align-items: baseline; } .ds-match-strip-state { margin-left: auto; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; background: #bff576; color: #15220f; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 750; }

components.name: Seat Chip
components.description: A solid ink chip for each player seat; never glass.
components.css: .ds-seat { position: absolute; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-width: 156px; padding: 9px 11px; border: 1px solid rgba(221,245,215,.12); border-radius: 12px; background: #0e2317; color: #eef5ee; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 7px 15px rgba(5,20,12,.14); } .ds-seat-avatar { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 9px; background: #293f31; color: #d5e9d3; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 850; } .ds-seat strong { display: block; font-size: 14px; } .ds-seat span { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: #b1c8b3; }

components.name: Playing Card
components.description: Ivory card stock; rank in two corners, one large suit centre.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; width: 64px; height: 90px; padding: 0; border: 1px solid #d8dfd6; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #fffefa, #f2f0e7); color: #17211b; box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.18); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 12px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.23), 0 0 0 2px #bff576; } .ds-card-corner { position: absolute; left: 6px; top: 5px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; line-height: 1; font-weight: 800; } .ds-card-corner strong { font-size: 14px; } .ds-card-corner span { font-size: 9px; } .ds-card-suit { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 34px; }

narrative.northStar: The club table, not the dashboard.
narrative.overview: The player came to play a hand, not to read a control panel. The table is the stage, with its own score stack and trump card; the match tiles sit in the top bar; the hand is a dock below it; the coach is evidence attached to the decision. Everything else is reference, kept quiet in one rail or folded below on a phone.
keyCharacteristics: One filled lime element at a time: the action that is actually available.
A deep green felt field with warm ivory cards and ink-coloured seat chips.
A compact match strip in the top bar replaces sidebar score, contract, and progress cards.
A single decision dock owns the hand, the bid controls, and the phone coach.
Plain-spoken coaching names the visible cards behind every claim.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: If more than one element on screen is filled lime, one of them is not an action.

rules.name: The Label Rule
rules.body: A label names a datum or a section. If it only announces the heading beneath it, delete it.

rules.name: The Match-Strip Rule
rules.body: Match state lives in one horizontal strip. It never returns to a sidebar card.

rules.name: The Etched Rule
rules.body: A surface earns depth from its edge and fill, not from a blur.

rules.name: The Next-Action Rule
rules.body: The current legal decision is the loudest thing in view; coaching attaches to it rather than competing with it.

dos: Do keep exactly one lime-filled action in view.
Do put the hand and the bid/play controls before the coach on phones.
Do name the visible card, count, or point total behind a coaching claim.
Do keep touch targets at 44px and body copy at 16px.
Do use tabular numerals for every score and percentage.
donts: Don't return to a three-column dashboard of equal panels.
Don't nest a card inside the decision dock; use a rule and spacing.
Don't use decorative eyebrows above headings; labels name data.
Don't use glass, gradient text, or card-face suit colours on dark surfaces.
Don't animate width, height, or layout properties; use transform and opacity.
